purpose: Controlled coordinate-loss restart at decision time, not a naturally occurring outage failure
missing_rule: Keep all eight geometry/protocol slots. Prefer the canonical trial7 basename/traj1; if absent, choose the lexicographically first trial7 manual filename in that slot by availability only. Record unavailable slots; never replace the trial or select using scores
shared_handoff: Same nominal-shadow body p, original shadow v and bias, and original shadow physical covariance; change R only
full_attitude_reuse: Fit once at nominal reference; exact +/-90/180 world-yaw reparameterizations retain the same eight-start grid and isotropic tilt prior. Verify first available +90 case by direct refitting and retain discrepancy
sensor_resampling: 100 Hz causal previous-sample hold for independently timestamped raw acc/gyro; native common InEKF uses adjacent held samples
candidate_radio: Existing window_inputs pair/time thinning, endpoint-clipped path, outage packets physically deleted
truth: No pose columns read during generation; score every saved nominal and perturbed case only after all decisions and future trajectories finish
selection: No condition on actual truth yaw, improvement or acceptance; include nominal jump=0
